notes: Fastest decode for coding: DFlash2 K=7 + n-gram file-copy drafting (~1.4x faster than MTP at one stream, big wins on turns that rewrite a file they just read). Trade-off: the DFlash2 draft model takes extra VRAM, so on this 24 GB card it fits only ~108-130k context beside a desktop instead of 262k. One lane (DFlash2's measured shape). Prefill chunk 2048 (not 4096): ~300 MiB less cuBLAS workspace, so --fit-context lands ~10k+ tokens higher; costs ~4% prefill speed only. Studio on, but does NOT auto-open the browser.
